name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 6 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-11-10, at wavelengths from 1.16 to 4.89 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
